get_diatomic_config: get the default FermiNet config for running a diatomic molecule simulation with QMC
create_diatomic_molecule: create a diatomic molecule from a config by parsing the molecule name and setting atom coordinates
lookup_bond_length: lookup the default bond length in angstroms for a known diatomic molecule from the BOND_LENGTHS dictionary
lookup_spin_polarisation: lookup the default spin polarisation value for a known diatomic molecule from the SPIN_POLARISATION dictionary
configure_bond_length_multiple: configure the bond length multiple on a diatomic config to scale interatomic distance for QMC runs
